authors.name: Gurpreet Singh
authors.bio: Gurpreet Singh founded House of Aspirants and writes its monthly current affairs magazine, its weekly live session summaries and the preparation strategy pages. He reviews the exam-oriented material published on this portal against the official syllabus and the official notifications, and mentors aspirants preparing for Punjab Police, PSSSB and PPSC examinations.

authors.name: House of Aspirants Editorial Team
authors.bio: The House of Aspirants editorial desk writes, fact-checks and reviews everything published on this portal - study notes, current affairs, magazine issues, quiz sets and exam notifications - against the official syllabus, the official notification and the source it cites.
